crossRefs.note: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in…
on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the…
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I…
Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good…

Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and…
Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things…
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

translations.web: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
translations.bsb: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
translations.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
translations.asv: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
